keyboard.behavior: Native modal focus navigation; only backdrop=false plus scroll=true opens a non-modal Drawer.
Requests hide when keyboard=true. With keyboard=false the modal attempt reports hidePrevented; explicit dismiss buttons still work.

guidelines: Reuse drawer drawer-bottom drawer-sheet on a native dialog. There is no BottomSheet export, separate Sass map, bottom-sheet class or bottom-sheet size/handle API.

drawer-sheet sets physical left/right/bottom to zero and a desktop width fallback; other Drawer size constraints still apply. It supplies no automatic safe-area padding or Bottom Sheet height API. The first example explicitly raises the height token for its mobile action links.
Default options are backdrop=true, keyboard=true and scroll=false. Modal state is backdrop || !scroll; scroll=false locks the root with dialog-open.
Keep the close control available. Swipe-down dismissal is capability-dependent and has no drag animation or snap-point API.
show/hide starts can be canceled; shown/hidden follow the transition. Calls during transitions are ignored. resize is an internal listener, not a dispatched lifecycle event.
For programmatic opening, supply the opener to show(opener), choose initial focus and implement any required focus-return policy; visible data-API triggers register their own return handler.

keyboard.behavior: Native showModal contains focus. Non-modal show does not make the rest of the document inert.
Requests hide when keyboard=true; disabled modal keyboard dismissal emits hidePrevented. A visible child tip handles the first Escape.
Activate a native button; a dismissal hook requests the cancelable hide operation.

guidelines: Use a native dialog, a visible labelled heading, and an explicit dismissal control. Author autofocus on the safest useful control.
Default modal=true uses showModal and locks the root with dialog-open. Non-modal mode does neither.
Data-API triggers register focus restoration when visible. Direct programmatic callers must deliberately arrange their focus policy.
show/hide are cancelable starts; shown/hidden notify after the transition callback. cancel is not the same as cancelable hide.
Backdrop=false changes outside-click handling, not modal focus semantics. Use modal=false for non-modal behavior.
Do not bypass framework hide with raw close/form method=dialog when lifecycle/scroll cleanup is required; coordinate native/application actions explicitly.
Nested tips use the open dialog container by default and are hidden during framework close. handleUpdate is an API-consistency no-op in this implementation.

Close when keyboard=true and focus is in the panel; a modal keyboard=false attempt emits hidePrevented.

guidelines: Functional drawers are named native dialog elements, not section elements with visibility/transform overrides.

Drawer options are read from the Drawer element. Responsive lg:drawer is static above lg and panel-like below it.
show/hide starts are cancelable; shown/hidden follow transition cleanup. resize is an internal listener, not a public lifecycle notification.
drawer-sheet is the supported core sheet class. Optional additional patterns must not be misrepresented as core aliases.
